summary: Homepage redesign retest: 7/7 UI acceptance criteria covered with 7 new browser checks, all passed. Pre-existing backend suite (fx rates, submissions) re-run clean as a sanity cross-check.

checks.criterion: The redesigned hero is visually complete and interactive
checks.name: hero-command-centre-interactive
checks.evidence: Desktop 1440px: hero copy left of command centre card (card x > heading x); GBP currency tab changed dashboard-cashflow-value; 12M horizon toggle got active class; ticker, margin card ($184k) and settlement card visible with no clipping. 375px: heading, both CTAs, and command centre visible with scrollWidth-clientWidth=0.

checks.criterion: Reported header, colour, and floating-control overlap issues are resolved
checks.name: floating-controls-no-overlap
checks.evidence: Hero heading starts below sticky header bottom edge. At 375px with switchyard-cookies cleared, WhatsApp button rect and cookie-banner rect do not intersect (CSS body:has() rule pushes button to bottom:15rem while banner is mounted). After Accept, banner unmounts and the button's CSS transition settles to ~16px from the viewport bottom within 2s (confirmed via polling) -- initial measurement without a settle-wait was flaky, resolved on rerun, not a bug.

checks.criterion: New CFO outcomes and animated metrics sections render correctly
checks.name: cfo-outcomes-and-metrics-render
checks.evidence: Three cfo-outcome-card elements visible with hover-triggered y-translate; four metric-N cards visible and AnimatedCounter text settled to '20+', '98%', '50+', '15 min' within 4s; sage label color resolved to a non-empty computed color on the dark section.

checks.name: exposure-scenarios-tabs-interactive
checks.evidence: Conservative/Balanced/Flexible tabs each set aria-selected=true on click, scenario-result-card stayed within viewport bounds for all three, and protected-outcome text was distinct per tab (no stale copy); tab also keyboard-focusable.

checks.name: client-proof-carousel-interactive
checks.evidence: Next changed client-story-quote from quote1 to a different quote2; Previous returned to quote1; at 375px the story card stayed within the viewport (no x-clipping) and Next worked post-resize.

checks.criterion: Scroll motion is smooth and accessible
checks.name: scroll-reveal-reduced-motion
checks.evidence: cfo-outcomes-section reached opacity>=0.9 after scrollIntoViewIfNeeded; with prefers-reduced-motion=reduce, .market-ticker animation-name computed to 'none' while hero heading and all three cfo-outcome-card elements remained visible (content preserved).

checks.name: homepage-regression-on-preview
checks.evidence: Run against public preview URL. Mobile hamburger menu opened and About nav link routed to /about; hedge-guide modal form submitted a tscheck-regress-<ts>@example.com lead and showed its *-form-success state; footer and privacy link visible; hero CTA links to cal.com; zero /api 4xx/5xx responses and zero non-benign console errors captured during the whole flow.

checks.criterion: (sanity cross-check, not in current matrix) Pre-existing backend API suite still healthy
checks.name: backend/tests (test_tscheck_fx_rates.py, test_tscheck_submissions.py)
checks.evidence: python -m pytest -q: 3 passed in 3.80s (GET /api/fx/rates, POST /api/submissions consent accept/reject).

notes.criterion: Reported header, colour, and floating-control overlap issues are resolved
notes.note: The WhatsApp button's return to its bottom corner after cookie dismissal relies on a CSS transition (duration-300) keyed off a body:has() selector losing its match when the cookie banner unmounts. Measuring the button's position immediately after the Accept click (no settle wait) reads a stale position for up to ~300ms; this is expected animation behavior, not a functional defect -- confirmed correct once given time to settle.
